# Frontmatter Constraints for Reserved OKF Filenames

The filename 'log.md' cannot have any frontmatter, while 'index.md' is allowed to have the key 'okf_version' in its frontmatter.

To enforce valid frontmatter structure for specific reserved filenames in the OKF documentation.
